description: Get the user's personal Albert Heijn offers (the Bonus Box, 'persoonlijke bonus'): deals picked for this member that only apply after they are activated. Returns max_activations (how many offers the member may activate this week), activated_count, and per offer: id, title, status ('activated' or 'available'), original_price, bonus_price, discount_percentage, unit, and product_id when the offer covers one product. For an offer on several products, pass its id as segment_id to ah_get_bonus_group_products to list them. Activate offers with ah_activate_personal_offer. Set period='next' for next week's offers once AH publishes them. When you mention a product or recipe from the result, link its name to its url.
name: ah_get_personal_offers
title: Albert Heijn: Personal Offers
